title: fix(app-shell): on the object route, a view that declares no `columns` applies neither `hiddenFields` nor `fieldOrder` (objectui#10694)
body:
Fixes #10694
Clause-②: no

On the object route, a view that declares no `columns` now applies neither `hiddenFields` nor `fieldOrder`. The hide-column toggle follows the seat's H3 ruling, comment 5839344270 (option B). This executes triage 5838443654 under claim 5838501194 (`domain:ui` seat 5, session `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`).

## The contract

`ListViewSchema.columns` says "An empty list declares no projection, so neither of them applies: which columns show is then left to the renderer". The composition docblock says "An EMPTY `columns` declares no projection, so steps 2 and 3 do not apply". Both quotes are `@objectstack/spec` source at objectstack `origin/main` (objectstack#19598). They are not in the released 17.4.0. PR objectui#10667 already applies this reading on `InterfaceListPage`.

## What changed

All code edits are in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`.

- **The views memo.** It still draws default columns into a grid-like view with no `columns`, and it now records every tab it fills (`derivedColumnViewIds`). The fallback "all records" tab is filled by the same loop, so it is recorded as well.
- **The gate.** `activeViewDeclaresColumns` is a boolean computed beside `activeView`. The stored tab answers through `activeTabDeclaresColumns`: its own non-empty `columns`, never the memo's fill. A panel draft answers instead only when its `columns` were actually changed (`draftColumnsEdited`, below). The relay's `hiddenFields` and `fieldOrder` rungs pass their value only when this is true, and `undefined` otherwise. `undefined` is needed because `...listSchema` already carries the host's echo of the view's keys. The relay keys on the boolean, not on the memo's Set (AGENTS.md #10).
- **An absent `columns` reads like `columns: []`.** The spec requires the key. On objectstack main it has no optional or default, and 17.4.0 `safeParse` without it fails with `invalid_union` at `columns`. So a stored body that lacks the key declares no projection either.
- **The hide-column toggle (ruling B).** Both `onHiddenFieldsChange` rungs now call one local, `persistHiddenFields`.
  - On a view that declares no projection and is not a saved view (`isSavedViewId`), the local writes nothing. `ListView` still hides the column in its own state, so the toggle is session-only there. This matches the interface page, whose toggle never persists.
  - A saved view keeps persisting as before. Its write is the whole view, drawn `columns` included, so the reload reads a view that declares a projection.
  - The author's remedy on a system view is to declare `columns`.
- **The panel draft (contract-review item 9, fixed on this branch).** `ViewConfigPanel` seeds its draft from `activeView`, whose `columns` on this route are the memo's drawn defaults, and it relays every flat field on any edit. So at `347e14870`, after an edit to any unrelated field (and still after Discard), the gate read the view as projected. The card's defect then came back in-session, and the ruled session-only toggle wrote an overlay `hiddenFields` again. Now `draftColumnsEdited` is true only when the draft's `columns` differ from the tab's by content, using `isSameOptionsValue`, the file's existing value comparison (AGENTS.md #10). Drawn defaults carried in a draft never count as a declared projection, and columns the admin changed still answer for themselves. No edit to `ViewConfigPanel.tsx` or `view-config-adapter.ts`.
- **Pin:** `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694.test.tsx`, 11 cases. Six are described under Verification. Five more go through the real `ViewConfigPanel`, opened by the host's own `onViewAction('settings')`, with only its inspector stubbed: four panel THE-FIX cases (an unrelated edit, then Discard, each asserting the unprojected draw and zero overlay writes from the toggle) and one panel CONTROL (columns the admin changed in the panel apply both keys).
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/10694-empty-columns-no-projection.md`, `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

Out of bounds, and untouched: the fetch and rows region (objectui#10684, which has since merged as PR objectui#10711), `VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS`, the spec, the `userActions` rung, and every held file.

## Premises, measured before the fix on base `1e946c9`

Every measurement here mounts the real app-shell `ObjectView`, the real `plugin-view` host and the real `ListView`. Only `object-grid` is stubbed, to record the columns it is handed.

- **H1 holds.**
  - The renderer's own columns for a `columns: []` view are `[name, stage, owner, amount, region]`.
  - The same view with `hiddenFields [stage]` and `fieldOrder [owner, name]` drew `[owner, name, amount, region]`.
  - A view with no `columns` key drew the same.
  - Control: the projection `[name, stage, owner, amount]` with both keys drew `[owner, name, amount]`, before and after the fix.
- **H2.** The gate is implemented as described above.
- **H3 is a real hazard, and the ruling settles it.** These readings are from a one-off probe that was not committed.
  - With the gate alone, a system view with `columns: []` and `userActions.hideFields: true` still hid the toggled column in-session. It still wrote an overlay `{hiddenFields: [region]}`, but the reload ignored that value.
  - The dispatch's suggested route does not work for system views. An overlay row carrying `columns` drew the defaults even on base, because `narrowPersonalizationOverlay` keeps only `VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS` (the objectstack#7494 / objectui#5233 ruling).
  - A saved view's toggle write already carried `columns` plus `hiddenFields`, and the reload applied it.
- **H4 census.** One row per file that reads `hiddenFields` or `fieldOrder`, plus the hosts that mount `ListView`:

| File | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` | composer, ungated on base; gated here |
| `app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx` | composer, gated (`viewComposes`, PR objectui#10667) |
| `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | the composer of record (`effectiveFields`). Gated by construction: an empty `columns` gives an empty projection, and the grid derives its own. Held; nothing to file |
| `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | relay only: hands `columns` raw (an empty list stays empty) and both keys to the host |
| `plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` | toggle UI only |
| `plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx`, `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `plugin-form/src` | read neither key; held |
| `plugin-list/src/ListViewBlock.tsx`, `app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx`, `app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` | read neither key |
| `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` | persists and narrows the overlay's `hiddenFields`; not a composer |
| `core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts`, `types/src/objectql.ts`, `types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` | a comment, and declarations |
| `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/*`, `apps/console/src/pages/system/*` | `SchemaForm` props of the same name, a different vocabulary |

## Verification

The final head `ff35fd006` is a merge of origin/main `434555857`. Every heavy run went through the shared verify lock.

- **The pin, three legs in one lock hold, on `d61a44173`.** Each swap was trap-restored and its blob hash checked on disk. After the last leg, the restore was verified: final blob `ff273eb5` = HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - Head: `Tests 11 passed (11)`, exit 0.
  - The previous head `347e14870`'s `ObjectView.tsx` (blob `516534e5`): `Tests 4 failed | 7 passed (11)`, exit 1. Exactly the four panel THE-FIX cases are red:
    - after an unrelated edit, the draw fails with `expected [ 'owner', 'name', 'amount', 'region' ] to deeply equal [ 'name', 'stage', 'owner', …(2) ]`, and the toggle fails with `expected [ [ 'duly_task', …(3) ] ] to deeply equal []`;
    - the same pair fails after Discard.

    Every CONTROL is green, including "columns the admin changed in the panel answer for themselves" (drew `[owner, name]`).
  - Base `1e946c9` (blob `69367e57`): `Tests 7 failed | 4 passed (11)`, exit 1. The seven THE-FIX cases are red, and the four CONTROLs are green.
- **Reach probe** (not committed): the real plugin view as admin draws 0 buttons titled Settings on the object route. The control, a bare `ViewSwitcher` with a `settings` view action, draws 1 (`Tests 2 passed (2)`). So the system-view entry to the panel is latent today, while the saved-view entry through the tab bar is reachable.
- **The full app-shell package, on the final head `ff35fd006`.**
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 821 passed | 1 skipped (822)`, `Tests 8287 passed | 9 skipped (8296)`.
  - Then `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 30 successful, 30 total`. The app-shell task was a cache miss and ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
  - Lock verdict: command-exit 0.
- **Lint, plain, on the two source files at `ff35fd006`:** exit 0, 0 errors. `ObjectView.tsx` has 171 warnings, the same as base; the pin has 9. Linting is not type-aware (`parserOptions.project` and `projectService` are unset), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **Gates on `ff35fd006`, lock-free, all exit 0:**
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape`.
  - `check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
  - `check:changeset-claims`: report-only.
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals` and `check-changeset-no-major`.
  - `check-changeset-presence`: `2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- **Open-PR re-read before the push:** 8 other open PRs, 1812 files, no overlap with the three paths.
- **Diff against origin/main `434555857`:** `ObjectView.tsx` +69/−12, pin +442, changeset +36.

These were not run locally and belong to CI: the full `pnpm test` farm, `Lint`, E2E and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- On a system view with no declared `columns`, the hide toggle is now session-only. Measured population with `hideFields: true`: one non-test authored instance in objectui (`ObjectDataPage`'s hardcoded surface, which never persists), and 0 in the objectstack examples of a local checkout. The author's remedy is to declare `columns`.
- Known edges, left as they are: columns the admin sets back to exactly the drawn defaults read as unedited. `handleViewAction('settings')` opens the panel with no `isSavedView` guard, unlike `handleConfigView`, but that entry is latent today (see the reach probe).
- Read from source, not measured: `ViewConfigPanel`'s `handlePatch` relays every flat field of its draft, including the drawn default `columns`. A panel save on a view with no projection therefore stores those defaults as the view's declared `columns`. That behaviour is unchanged here. It is not class a/b/c, and no one has been named to take it up.
